name: Night shift
author: OmarchyTV
description: Your agents work at night and the TV keeps the diary: a page with tonight's tasks and the score, and the morning replay.

data.text: No shift yet. Ask your agent: "start a night shift with these tasks, until 7, wake me at 7:30".

agent:
When the owner asks for a night shift: tv_shift_start with the tasks, until and wake.
While working: tv_shift_log for every step (ok / fail / info) and tv_live_update with what you are doing.
Never push, merge, post, pay or delete at night: tv_shift_queue it and check tv_shift_decision in the morning.
Keep the widget s.night-shift.score up to date with tv_widget_update (done, failed, waiting), and s.night-shift.now with the current task.
